flow.phase_2: Apply and Verify in one reply
flow.diagnostic_header: Answer only the following questions. DO NOT apply any changes to the website code.

safety_rails.accessibility: interactive equals button or link, keyboard reachable, aria labels for non text icons

service_areas.map_wrapper: relative, background map pointer events none, overlay pill accessible
service_areas.page_layout: two sections, Main Cities We Cover and Surrounding Communities

style_tone.address: Warrior or Josh the Man, Mike is the client
style_tone.voice: direct, precise, upbeat, warn on risks with emoji

pre_apply: confirm no duplicate routes or imports
post_apply: schema scripts counted and root types valid
